newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soy products end lower despite China buying.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soy products end lower despite China buying.

text.p: CBOT soy product futures closed lower despite confirmation China recently purchased U.S. soy products, traders said.
USDA this week confirmed China bought 20,000 tonnes of U.S. soyoil and Singapore traders said China bought 50,000 tonnes of U.S. soymeal.
Also, USDA's weekly export sales report released early Friday was viewed as bullish for the soy complex, they said.
But technical indicators, including the four and 20-day moving averages, remained bearish, the traders said.

Cargill Inc sold 800 lots of December soymeal and sold 300 lots of January, traders said. Cargill also sold 450 lots of December soyoil and ADM Investor Services sold 250 lots of January soyoil, they said.
Soyoil closed 0.08 to 0.25 cent per lb lower, with October down 0.08 at 22.82. Soymeal closed $0.20 to $4.00 per ton lower, with October down $2.40 at $234.40.
